payload.author: claude
payload.body: DECISION (user): pure-Rust only — do NOT add OpenSSL (the samael crate pulls it; the workspace has stayed pure-rustls/no-native-deps). Consequence: SAML is DEFERRED. The blocker is XML canonicalization (c14n11/exclusive-c14n) — there is no mature pure-Rust c14n+XML-dsig library, and hand-rolling c14n + signature-wrapping defenses is an auth-bypass risk not worth taking autonomously. Revisit when a vetted pure-Rust XML-dsig/c14n path exists (or reconsider the OpenSSL trade-off). The auth_saml_seen_assertions store + the FR-214/215/216 audit-fix requirements are already captured here.
